item.title: W-Player 0.1.2
item.description:
• Each card says where its video is, with badges on the picture: Desktop, Lock Screen, Screen Saver (as macOS has them, so a wallpaper picked in System Settings shows too). The blue frame around the desktop's video is gone.
  • A click on a card asks where the video goes: Set as Wallpaper (the desktop and the Lock Screen), or Show On › Desktop, Lock Screen and Menu Bar, Screen Saver, ticked where it is now. Unticking Desktop takes the video off the desktop, so macOS's own wallpaper shows there. A right-click opens the same menu.
  • Placing a video on the Lock Screen says it's busy under the grid until macOS has it (converting it and restarting macOS's wallpaper service takes a few seconds).
  • Find Videos moved to the bottom of the window, away from the toolbar's own buttons.
  • The Lock Screen item says Menu Bar too: on a Mac the Lock Screen is the system wallpaper, which also colours the menu bar, so a video on the Lock Screen only still sets the menu bar's colours.
